evals.description: Given a review report where two findings are real in-scope bugs and three findings expand scope (new persistent state, credential lifecycle, speculative plan guarantee), a driver following the skill must produce a visible disposition for every finding and must not classify any scope-expanding finding as actionable now.
assertions: Every finding ID from the report appears in the driver output with an explicit disposition.
RRD-001 and RRD-002 are classified actionable now.
RRD-003, RRD-004, and RRD-005 are classified defer or reject, never actionable now.
No scope-expanding finding is silently folded into the plan or fix list.
